title: HB 2586 (107th General Assembly): As introduced, requires secretary of state to publicize the photo identification requirement at least 30 days prior to early voting for the primary and general elections in 2012 via public service announcements on radio and television. - Amends TCA Title 2 and Title 8, Chapter 3.

(section) 2-7-112(g) new (Section 1)
(quote) (g) At least thirty (30) days prior to the occurrence of early voting for any primary and regular elections in 2012, the secretary of state shall undertake appropriate activities to inform and remind the citizens of this state of the requirements of Chapter 323 of the Public Acts of 2011, including, but not limited to, the requirement that photo identification must be presented in order to vote at the polling place. Such promotional activities shall include, but not necessarily be limited to, public service announcements on radio and television.
(other) Section 2: effective on becoming law.
(other) Caption also cites Title 8, Chapter 3 but the saved body amends only 2-7-112.
(other) version: 522292-Draft (2012-01-13): the only saved version; publicity duty only (slot e). It confirms by reference that Chapter 323 of the Public Acts of 2011 requires photo ID at the polling place.
(other) note: Subcommittee amendment text is not saved. Deferred in full committee twice, taken off notice 2012-04-11. The Draft changes no ID rule; it only orders public announcements.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
